domain_exhaustiveness: arangeCheck_none, admission_none, shapeCases_complete and shapeCases_length prove the complete natural-shape success domain and all natural-shape rejection complements. Raw frontend replay independently checks all 231 successes and all 210 size-cap failures among individually admitted ranges. The nine symbolic rejection cases describe a complete disjoint classifier partition; they are not claimed to be exhaustive because of representative tests.
primitive_failure_semantics: Four independent flags represent ordinary API errors, not a successful-execution oracle. The theorem is unconditional in all flags. Launch setup may fail before frontend entry; frontend rejection precedes backend/runtime failure. The successful route still calls Host.run, and the proof derives successful execution and values from matrix_transpose_host_correctness.
dtype_exhaustiveness: The original wrapper supplies only fp16 pointers. All sampled 16-bit payloads, including NaN payloads and signed zeros, are preserved. arange/strides use int32; admitted offsets are bounded far below signed overflow. There is no other production dtype dispatch.
caller_boundary: Canonical natural shape dimensions are the source-grounded supported API. Arbitrary Python objects and negative dimensions are not new successful routes and are handled by the trusted Torch shape/allocation API. Observed rejected examples remain documented, including second-position bool accepted by randn then rejected by zeros after shape reversal. No universal caller-type classification is claimed.
memory_and_schedule: The original grid has one program. Fresh distinct allocations discharge output alias/freshness constraints. Output injectivity and complete loading before storing are proved by the existing host/kernel contracts. Full success memory equality and frame are retained. The new arithmetic bound establishes representability of element indices and both fp16 bytes; normal pointer/storage/load-store implementation remains trusted.
known_false_claims_avoided: Positive power-of-two dimensions alone suffice without the product cap.
Frontend IR generation establishes GPU or full native backend success.
